answer_1.quote: CR-Walker finally generates responses with a conditional language generation module.
answer_1.outputs: system utterances in conversational recommender systems

answer_2.quote: We apply BLEU and Distinct-n to measure the generated response on word-level matches and diversity.

answer_4.quote: In addition to automatic evaluation, we conduct point-wise human evaluation. 300 posts are randomly sampled from the test set. For each response generated by each model, we ask 3 worker from AMT to give their ratings according to each metric with a 3-point scale (3/2/1 for good/fair/bad respectively).
answer_4.guideline: Workers rated responses on a 3-point scale for fluency, coherence, informativeness, and effectiveness.
